title: QD-PINN:A Physics-Informed Neural Network Approach to Bayesian Quickest Detection in High-Dimensional Diffusions
abstract: arXiv:2610.37473v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Quickest detection problems (QDPs) arise in a wide range of applications. However, the complementarity structure of the associated variational inequalities poses substantial challenges for traditional numerical methods, particularly in high-dimensional settings. We propose a PINN-based framework for estimating the optimal stopping boundary in QDPs with high-dimensional diffusion processes and spatial dependence, while overcoming the curse of dimensionality. Theoretically, we establish a novel equivalence between the free-boundary PDE and an infinite-dimensional stochastic optimization problem, rigorously justifying the use of finite-dimensional neural networks to approximate the true solution. Furthermore, we assess the robustness of the proposed framework by quantifying uncertainty in the learned stopping boundaries using deep ensembles and Monte Carlo dropout. translated_title: QD-PINN：一种基于物理信息神经网络的贝叶斯高维扩散过程最快检测方法
translated_abstract: 最快检测问题（QDPs）广泛应用于众多领域。然而，相关变分不等式的互补性结构给传统数值方法带来了巨大挑战，尤其是在高维场景下。我们提出了一种基于物理信息神经网络（PINN）的框架，用于估计具有高维扩散过程和空间相关性的最快检测问题中的最优停时边界，同时克服维数灾难。在理论方面，我们建立了自由边界偏微分方程与无穷维随机优化问题之间的新型等价关系，从而严格论证了使用有限维神经网络逼近真实解的合理性。此外，我们通过使用深度集成和蒙特卡洛Dropout对学习到的停时边界进行不确定性量化，评估了所提框架的鲁棒性。结果表明，在多次独立训练运行和随机过程中变异性较低。
tldr: 本文提出基于物理信息神经网络的QD-PINN框架，通过建立自由边界偏微分方程与无穷维随机优化问题之间的新型等价关系，实现了对高维扩散过程中贝叶斯最快检测最优停时边界的高效估计，并克服了维数灾难。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes QD-PINN, a physics-informed neural network framework that establishes a novel equivalence between free-boundary PDEs and infinite-dimensional stochastic optimization to efficiently estimate optimal stopping boundaries for Bayesian quickest detection in high-dimensional diffusions, overcoming the curse of dimensionality.
